ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; surface consists of >99% low-intensity (black) pixels with near-zero high-intensity distribution across the primary ventral plane.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression; interior angle estimated at 135-145 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-12 pixels; serrations are more densely clustered and jagged on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge sweep terminating in sharp, tapered lateral tips; leading edge exhibits a broad convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: High-contrast white scarring or terminal pigmentation clusters visible at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
